text: サファリ　ゾーンの　えんちょう　おとし　なのに　すごく　げんきよ　でも…「は」は　ぜんぶ　いれば　らしい　けど

structure.jp: サファリ　ゾーンの　えんちょう
「は」は　ぜんぶ　いれば　らしい　けど
structure.en: apparently his teeth are all false teeth, though

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', joining two things that don't seem to fit together. After a naming word it needs な in front. おとし なのに = 'even though he is old'.

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい says that this is what the speaker has heard, not something she knows for sure. いれば らしい = 'apparently they are false teeth'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど at the end of a sentence means 'though', softening what was just said. いれば らしい けど = 'they're apparently false teeth, though'.
